notices.summary: HubSpot sunsets the Pipelines API v1 on December 4, 2026. Calls to /crm-pipelines/v1 stop working then. The pipelines API under /crm/v3/pipelines returns the same pipelines and stages with different field names: id instead of pipelineId and stageId, archived instead of active, and ISO 8601 date-time strings for createdAt and updatedAt. Source: developers.hubspot.com/changelog/pipelines-api-v1-sunset. Drafted by Tiltmeter from HubSpot's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by HubSpot.

changes.note: Stops working on December 4, 2026. notices.summary: Anthropic has retired 12 Claude model versions, the latest on August 5, 2026. Requests that name them fail: Claude 2.0 and 2.1, Claude 3 Sonnet, Opus and Haiku, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Haiku, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and Claude Sonnet 4, Opus 4 and Opus 4.1. Each change names the recommended replacement and, in its note, what requests to it must leave out. Source: platform.claude.com model deprecations. Drafted by Tiltmeter from Anthropic's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by Anthropic.

changes.note: Retired on August 5, 2026: requests with this model fail. claude-opus-4-8 is Anthropic's recommended replacement. Requests to it must leave out temperature, top_p, top_k, extended thinking (budget_tokens: use adaptive thinking with output_config.effort) and a prefilled final assistant turn, or they return a 400 error.

Retired on June 15, 2026: requests with this model fail. claude-sonnet-5-5 is Anthropic's recommended replacement. Requests to it must leave out temperature, top_p, top_k, extended thinking (budget_tokens: use adaptive thinking with output_config.effort), thinking type disabled, a prefilled final assistant turn and a forced tool_choice, or they return a 400 error. It thinks by default, so max_tokens covers thinking and answer.

notices.summary: Groq no longer serves 16 models it retired, the latest on August 16, 2026. Requests that name them return an error. llama-3.3-70b-versatile and llama-3.1-8b-instant went last, for free and developer-tier keys, after Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, DeepSeek and Qwen models retired between 2024 and 2026. Each change names Groq's recommended replacement. Source: console.groq.com/docs/deprecations. Drafted by Tiltmeter from Groq's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by Groq.

changes.note: Shut down on August 16, 2026: requests that name it return an error. The shutdown applies to free and developer-tier keys; Groq enterprise customers with a committed-spend contract keep the model. Groq recommends openai/gpt-oss-120b (its other suggestion, qwen/qwen3.6-27b, was itself shut down on September 14, 2026). openai/gpt-oss-120b and openai/gpt-oss-20b are reasoning models: they reason before they answer, and that reasoning counts toward the completion token limit.

notices.summary: Spotify changed its Web API for Development Mode apps in February 2026. Apps without extended quota are affected, existing ones since March 9: playlist /tracks endpoints and the tracks field become items; batch fetches, top tracks, browse and markets are gone; saves go through /me/library; popularity, followers, label, email, country and product are no longer returned. Source: Spotify's migration guide. Drafted by Tiltmeter from Spotify's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by Spotify.

notices.summary: Hugging Face retired the serverless Inference API at api-inference.huggingface.co. Its domain no longer resolves (checked October 27, 2026), so requests fail. HF Inference answers at router.huggingface.co/hf-inference with the same requests and responses per task, and the OpenAI-compatible chat API moved to router.huggingface.co/v1. Source: huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers. Drafted by Tiltmeter from Hugging Face's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by Hugging Face.

changes.note: Same request body and response for the model's task. HF Inference needs a token (Bearer hf_...) with the Inference Providers permission, and since July 2025 it serves mostly CPU models such as embeddings and classifiers; large chat models are served through router.huggingface.co/v1/chat/completions.

The task now comes after the model. Same body (inputs) and the same array of embeddings back. HF Inference needs a token (Bearer hf_...) with the Inference Providers permission, and since July 2025 it serves mostly CPU models such as embeddings and classifiers; large chat models are served through router.huggingface.co/v1/chat/completions.

Send the model id in the body's model field instead of the path; the router picks a provider that serves it. An OpenAI client's base URL changes from https://api-inference.huggingface.co/v1 to https://router.huggingface.co/v1.
Same OpenAI-compatible body and response. An OpenAI client's base URL becomes https://router.huggingface.co/v1.

notices.summary: Stripe API version 2025-03-31.basil moved subscription billing periods to the items. The Subscription no longer has current_period_start and current_period_end; read them from each item in items.data instead. It applies only to accounts and requests on API version 2025-03-31 or later; older versions still return both on the Subscription. Source: docs.stripe.com/changelog/basil/2025-03-31. Drafted by Tiltmeter from Stripe's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by Stripe.
notices.applies_to: Accounts and requests on API version 2025-03-31.basil or later. Older API versions still return current_period_start and current_period_end on the Subscription.

notices.summary: Jira Cloud removed GET and POST /rest/api/3/search and /rest/api/2/search, which answer 410 Gone. Their replacements, /rest/api/3/search/jql and /rest/api/2/search/jql, page with nextPageToken instead of startAt, return no total, and return only issue ids unless the request names its fields. Jira Server and Data Center keep the old endpoints. Source: developer.atlassian.com/changelog/#CHANGE-2046. notices.applies_to: Jira Cloud sites (*.atlassian.net and api.atlassian.com/ex/jira). Jira Server and Data Center keep the old endpoints.

To count matching issues, POST /rest/api/3/search/approximate-count with body {"jql": "..."}; it returns {"count": n}.

notices.summary: OpenWeather closed One Call API 2.5 in June 2024. Requests to /data/2.5/onecall and /data/2.5/onecall/timemachine fail with 401 Unauthorized. One Call API 3.0 serves the same data at /data/3.0/onecall with the same parameters and format; it needs the One Call API subscription, which includes 1,000 free calls a day. Source: openweathermap.org/one-call-transfer. Drafted by Tiltmeter from OpenWeather's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by OpenWeather.

changes.note: Closed in June 2024. 3.0 takes the same parameters (lat, lon, exclude, units, lang, appid) and returns the same format. The API key's account needs the One Call API subscription, or requests return 401.
Closed in June 2024. 3.0 takes lat, lon, dt (one Unix timestamp), appid, units and lang, and returns the weather for that single timestamp in a data array instead of current and hourly.
3.0 returns only the requested timestamp: request each hour separately.

notices.summary: Slack sunset files.upload on November 12, 2025. An upload now takes three steps: files.getUploadURLExternal with filename and length returns upload_url and file_id; POST the bytes to upload_url; then files.completeUploadExternal with files (a JSON array of id and title) and channel_id or channels. The SDKs wrap this as files_upload_v2 (Python) and files.uploadV2 (Node). Source: docs.slack.dev. Drafted by Tiltmeter from Slack's public documentation; not signed or endorsed by Slack.

changes.note: Replaced by the three-step upload the summary describes, each step with the same bot token: files.getUploadURLExternal, a POST of the bytes to upload_url (application/octet-stream), and files.completeUploadExternal. completeUploadExternal takes channel_id for one channel or channels for comma-separated IDs, and returns the shared file in files.
